snippet.title: Cinderia Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Cinderia launches in Early Access on Steam on March 30, 2026!
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214610/Cinderia/

Cinderia is a fast-paced rogue-lite action game of pure exhilaration. Freely combine everything you can see — skills, combos, passives, and equipment — to create your own distinct fighting style. Darkness has swallowed the land, yet a faint glimmer still flickers among the ruins.
